1048056902.description: Sing along with this spooky song book! Just push a button and start singing! Sing along with 5 of your favorite spooky songs! This board book also features a carrying handle for easy travel: bring along and sing along! Songs featured in this book are Little Ghost, Is Yo8ur Face Bright Green, Three Black Bats, Ten Little Monsters, and Trick or Treat.

1048056903.description: What's in Ms. Rachel's Magic Halloween Box? Find out in this sturdy lift-the-flap board book! Little ones will love learning about opposites with Ms. Rachel, beloved educator and YouTube phenomenon. This board book includes flaps to lift on every spread, perfect for aiding the development of fine motor skills. Play along with Ms. Rachel and Herbie in this interactive story celebrating Halloween! Ms. Rachel is a passionate educator who creates research-based videos to help toddlers and their families learn, bond, and thrive. Her videos infuse songs, games and nursery rhymes with strategies from experts to help children reach important milestones in the crucial early years of learning. Rachel believes all children are capable, brilliant and important. She loves learning from them and being around their contagious joy and wonder. Ms. Rachel has two master's degrees in education. She has one in early childhood development and one in music education. She is an advocate for children's rights and works to ensure that all children have access to high quality early childhood education. She is an ambassador for Save the Children and Room to Grow.

1048056904.description: The ArtSkills 13 Days of Halloween Craft Advent Calendar is a hands-on Halloween countdown kit that lets kids create 13 spooky crafts before Halloween. Instead of opening a traditional advent calendar for candy or small surprises, children open the windows of a haunted house to reveal a new craft activity. It is a fun, creative way to build excitement for the season while giving families an easy, screen-free activity to enjoy together.

1048056905.description: Celebrate Halloween with the Disney Halloween Plush! Ideal for Disney enthusiasts, collectors, and kids aged 2 years and up, this adorable plush is a delightful surprise for any occasion. Whether as a gift or a decorative piece, it's sure to bring smiles and spooky fun to all. Choose from Mickey Mouse Pumpkin or Ghost, and Minnie Mouse Pumpkin or Ghost.

1048056906.description: Member's Mark Decorative Woven Storage Baskets (Set of 4) deliver durable, decorative storage with nesting convenience to help keep shelves and rooms organized.

1048056907.description: From kreepy krawlies in the pool, to Dad eating the last ice block, every day is filled with surprises for Bluey and Bingo! Find out all the ways the Heelers have a screaming good time in this lift-the-flap board book that's perfect for Bluey fans based on the wildly successful animated series Bluey, as seen on Disney+! Bluey follows the adventures of a lovable and inexhaustible blue heeler who lives with her mum, dad, and little sister, Bingo. Along with her friends and family, Bluey enjoys exploring the world and using her imagination to turn everyday life into an amazing adventure. Bluey brings laughter and joy to all families.

1048056908.description: Experience a spook-tacular Halloween with Bluey and Bingo through these coloring and activity pages, along with 30 included magnets and 6 play scenes.Bluey and her sister Bingo are so excited for Halloween. The spooky fun is never done in this play case with an activity pad full of mazes, coloring, and more. Pick Bluey and Bingo's costumes, fill their house with spooky decorations, pick your favorite Halloween candy, and so much more. Young Bluey fans can use the 30 magnets to decorate the 6 play scenes for extended fun in this interactive format.There's no better way to entertain kids on road trips or long flights than books with engaging activities. From coloring books, to magnetic playsets, to storybooks with mini play figures, travel time can be turned into sessions of imagination, learning and play. This travel friendly activity kit is designed to pack well; compact and sturdy, they include everything a child would need for hours of play on‑the‑go.

1048056909.description: Jack and Sally are "truly meant to be" . . . or are they? Discover the next chapter in their story, penned by New York Times best-selling author Shea Ernshaw.

1048056910.description: The Member's Mark Set of 2 Talking Skeletons brings a lively and entertaining twist to your Halloween décor. These skeletons are designed with locking joints, allowing you to pose them in various positions—whether waving, sitting in a chair, or lounging on the floor. Add a hat or wig to personalize their look and create endless possibilities for spooky fun.

1048056911.description: Enhance your autumn and Halloween décor with the Set of 3 Iron Pumpkins with LED Candles. These beautifully crafted iron pumpkins bring a touch of elegance and warmth to your space, making them perfect for seasonal celebrations.

1048056913.description: Make your holiday season unforgettable with the Member's Mark 32" Pre-lit Decorated Wreath, exclusively available at Sam's Club. Crafted with a mix of lush, life-like Noble fir, pine, cedar, and juniper, this wreath is adorned with gold glittered berries, faceted ornaments in sage green, champagne gold, pearlized and shiny red, and hunter green. Gold-painted cone clusters and faux red berries add a festive touch, while the velvet ribbon and gold faux pinecones at the center bring sophistication and drama. The removable pinecone cluster allows for customization, and a coordinating garland is available separately.

1048056915.description: Transform your holiday display with the Member's Mark 76" Pre-Lit Color-Changing Buck, available exclusively at Sam's Club. Standing tall at just over 76", this stunning buck features a sturdy metal frame and a light motion collar, making it a captivating centerpiece for your seasonal decorations.

1048056917.description: Bring the magic of the holiday season to your home with the Member's Mark® 7.5' Linden Fir Pre-Lit Christmas Tree. This stunning centerpiece features 800 color-changing LED lights with 11 twinkling functions, creating a dazzling light show that will captivate your family and guests. Its rich foliage and lifelike design evoke the beauty of a real fir tree, making it the perfect addition to your festive décor.

1048056919.description: Add a touch of sophistication to your holiday decorations with the Member's Mark Pre-Lit Gift Box or Ornament Decor. Standing at an impressive 42 inches, these pieces feature chasing Warm White lights on the bow and Pure White lights on the ornament. With 5 preset lighting functions—Steady On, Twinkle, Slow Glow, Sequential, and Waving Lights—you can create the perfect festive ambiance indoors or outdoors.

1048056922.description: Celebrate the holidays in style with the Member's Mark 12' Silverthorn Fir Pre-Lit Christmas Tree. Designed with mixed PE and PVC tips, this tree offers a lifelike appearance that mimics the beauty of a natural fir. Its perfect profile and realistic foliage make it a stunning centerpiece for your home or business.

1048056925.description: Transform your home this holiday season with the Member's Mark 9' Prelit Holiday Garland, exclusively available at Sam's Club. Crafted with a mix of lush, life-like Noble fir, pine, cedar, and juniper, this garland is adorned with gold glittered berries, faceted ornaments in sage green, champagne gold, pearlized and shiny red, and hunter green. Gold-painted cone clusters and faux red berries add the perfect finishing touch, making it a timeless piece that complements any décor. Pair it with the coordinating wreath, sold separately, for a cohesive holiday look.

1048056926.description: Transform your holiday décor with the Member's Mark™ 6' Pre-Lit Grand Nutcracker with Carousel. Standing a striking six feet tall, this intricately designed nutcracker is dressed in a traditional uniform featuring vibrant red, deep navy, and gleaming gold accents. Its commanding presence makes it the perfect focal point for any festive setting.

1048056928.description: Immerse your home in the timeless charm of the holiday season with the Animated Storybook Decor. This stunning piece combines artistry, animation, and festive spirit, making it a perfect centerpiece for Christmas displays or a thoughtful gift for classic ballet enthusiasts.

1048056930.description: Transform your space into a winter wonderland with the Member's Mark 72'' Pre-Lit Crystal Iced Snowman. Standing an impressive 6 feet tall, this dazzling sculpture features a crystal-inspired acrylic body that sparkles like freshly fallen snow under moonlight. Perfect for indoor or covered outdoor use, it creates a captivating focal point for your holiday décor.

1048056931.description: Elevate your festive decorations with the Member's Mark 12' Pre-Lit Multicolor Lightshow Tree. Featuring gracefully draped light strands from top to base and a pre-lit star crowning the design, this tree creates a mesmerizing display that will captivate everyone's attention.

1048056933.description: Add a touch of elegance and warmth to your holiday celebrations with these 14-ounce Carousel candles. Crafted with a soy wax blend, these candles are encased in beautifully decorative containers, combining functionality with style. Designed to burn cleanly and slowly, they feature cotton wicks and premium scented oils that fill your space with captivating seasonal aromas.

1048056934.description: Bring festive cheer to your home with the Member's Mark 5' Pre-Lit Color-Changing Snowman, available exclusively at Sam's Club. Standing at an impressive 5 feet tall, this charming snowman features a sturdy metal frame and is adorned with delightful details like a top hat, scarf, and mittens, making it a standout addition to your holiday display.

1048056936.description: Elevate your festive decorations with the Member's Mark 72'' Pre-Lit Stacked Crystal Iced Gift Box. Standing an impressive 6 feet tall, this dazzling centerpiece mimics elegantly wrapped presents dusted with frost. Its intricate crystal-inspired PVC panels reflect and refract light, creating a magical winter glow that captivates any space.

1048056937.description: Elevate your holiday decorations with the Member's Mark Animated Deer Family. This exclusive set features three lifelike deer crafted with elegant gold twisted foil material and adorned with removable red bows. Their dramatic presence, combined with warm white LED lights and a cool white random fading effect, brings sparkle and charm to your yard, creating a festive and magical atmosphere.

1048056940.description: Transform your holiday season with this stunning artificial tree, designed to bring the charm of nature into your home. Each tree features incredibly realistic, full branches that create a cozy and natural look, making it the perfect centerpiece for your festive decorations.

1048056941.description: Transform your space into a winter wonderland with the Member's Mark Set of 2 Pre-Lit Leaping Deer. These stunning sculptures feature dynamic mid-leap poses, capturing a moment of joyful motion. Adorned with a shimmering, crystal-like finish, they refract light beautifully, creating a dazzling iridescent glow that adds elegance and whimsy to any holiday setting.

1048056944.description: Bring holiday cheer to your home with the Member's Mark Pre-Lit Motion Activated Musical Mailbox. Standing 48 inches tall, this mailbox features a real mail slot and chasing marquee lights that create a magical ambiance. Approaching the mailbox activates one of four festive songs, while inserting a letter triggers the two-color changing candy cane for added excitement.

1048056945.description: Add a touch of sophistication to your home with the Member's Mark Set of 3 Twinkling LED Globe Lights. Perfect for trees, roofs, porches, and more, these classic globes are designed to elevate your holiday décor effortlessly. With easy setup, simply unbox and display for instant charm.

1048056946.description: Take a nostalgic trip down Memory Lane this Christmas with Member's Mark 50ct Vintage LED C9 Lights. Featuring a filament inside each bulb, these lights combine retro charm with the brightness and efficiency of LED technology. Available in Warm White, Multicolor, and Ceramic Multicolor, these flicker-free lights are perfect for creating a festive atmosphere both indoors and outdoors.

1048056948.description: Celebrate a spectacular Halloween with this spooky coloring kit that comes with 8 markers and over 30 glow-in-the-dark stickers. Sweet spookiness abounds in the newest offering in the best-selling ColorWorld series. This haunted coloring set comes with 8 jumbo markers, and dozens of adorable Halloween scenes to color, all illustrated by the talented Felicity French. With werewolf ballerinas, baby vampires, supernatural trick-or-treaters, and so much more, it's hours of Halloween coloring fun. With more than 30 glow-in-the-dark stickers included, this is the perfect gift for kids who love to celebrate the spooky season. Having moved around a lot over the years—from the Orkney islands to Bournemouth on the south coast of England—Felicity French has a love for the countryside and the coast that inspires her illustrative style. She draws everything by hand and has a fine collection of pens. Her favorite things to draw include animals, birds, and flowers, taking inspiration from the outdoors and being surrounded by nature. She likes to incorporate pattern into her work and is especially inspired by Scandinavian and Paisley design. She has illustrated many coloring books...

1048056949.description: Transform your festive décor with the Member's Mark 6' Pre-Lit Prismatic Nutcracker. Standing an impressive 6 feet tall, this eye-catching decoration serves as a striking focal point, perfect for creating a memorable holiday atmosphere.

1048056950.description: Slip into a satin skirt designed for effortless movement and elevated everyday style, the Edited by Maren Morris Slip Skirt. Designed in soft satin fabric, this high-rise silhouette sits at the natural waist with an elasticized waistband for a comfortable, flexible fit. It's fitted through the hips before falling into a soft, fluid drape that hits at a flattering mid-calf length, creating a streamlined shape that feels polished yet effortless. Paisley and Black are finished with a delicate lace trim for a romantic touch, while Deep Depths and Ombre feature a clean finish hem for a more minimal, modern feel.Style it with a fitted tee and boots for an easy daytime look, or pair it with a sleek bodysuit and heels for a more elevated night-out outfit. It also works with a cozy knit and loafers for a relaxed but refined feel that carries seamlessly from day to evening.

1048056951.description: Transform your holiday decor with the Member's Mark Pre-lit Twinkling Animated Snowglobe. Standing an impressive 80 inches tall, this oversized Snowglobe features a waving Santa and dazzling chasing lights around the outer ring. With 380 total LED lights, it's a show-stopping centerpiece that will captivate your neighborhood and spread festive cheer.

1048056954.description: The Member's Mark 7-Piece Flameless LED Wax Candles are crafted from real paraffin wax, emitting a warm-white glow that mimics the ambiance of genuine candlelight. These candles ensure home safety, eliminating the risk of open flames, making them an ideal choice for households with children and pets. The flameless technology allows for worry-free enjoyment, while the smooth, natural ivory candle shell adds a touch of elegance to your décor.

1048056956.description: Taste the ocean with this wonderful variety of premium seafood products! Farm raised Jumbo Raw Shrimp are sized right to wow your guests. Dry Sea Scallops with garlic butter makes preparation a breeze. These 3-4 ounce cold water lobster tails are perfect for surf-and-turf or a special twin lobster tail main course. And the Norwegian Boneless and Skinless Atlantic Salmon is perfectly portioned to 5-ounce pieces to satisfy you and your family. Perfect for your next special feast or to stock up your freezer.

1048056957.description: Hanna's 36-oz. 5-wick luxury candles are the embodiment of opulence. More than just a source of light, these candles are symbols of sophistication, crafted with precision and care. The candles feature a meticulous blend of high-quality waxes and premium fragrance oils, creating an unparalleled olfactory experience. Each candle is infused with rich, complex scents that transport the senses and elevate any space.

1048056958.description: Elevate your dining experience with this 2-pack of convertible salt and pepper shakers. Designed for convenience and style, these shakers are perfect for seasoning your favorite dishes with ease.

1048056959.description: Bring the Fun with Disney's Minnie Mouse CostumeTransform into everyone's favorite mouse with this officially licensed Disney Minnie Mouse costume. Perfect for dress-up fun, themed parties, or Halloween, this delightful outfit lets young fans embrace Minnie's timeless charm and playful personality.

1048056960.description: Relax in comfort with this 2-piece pajama set, featuring one top and one pant. Designed for both style and ease, this set is perfect for lounging at home or enjoying a restful night's sleep. The soft fabric ensures a cozy feel, making it a must-have addition to your sleepwear collection.

1048056961.description: The Member's Mark Girls' Dynamic Knit Bomber is designed for all-day comfort with ultra-soft, stretchy fabric that allows easy movement. Its modern fit ensures lasting softness, making it ideal for active kids who love to stay on the go.

1048056962.description: These 4-pack bodysuits are designed to provide both comfort and style for your little one. Made from soft, breathable fabric, they ensure a cozy fit while allowing freedom of movement. Perfect for everyday wear, these bodysuits are a must-have addition to your baby's wardrobe.

1048056963.description: The Edited by Maren Morris Long Sleeve Bodysuit is a sleek, flattering essential designed with a classic crew neck and long sleeves that create a clean, streamlined look. It features cheeky coverage with a two-snap bottom closure for easy wear and a smooth fit. Black and White colorways are crafted from a stretchy, super soft rib knit fabric for everyday comfort. Cow, Leopard, and Paisley prints are offered in mesh with a lined bodice and sheerer sleeves for a lighter, statement-making feel. Designed to layer effortlessly or stand alone, it's a versatile piece that moves easily from day to night with a confident, modern finish in any wardrobe essential. Whether styled with denim, tailored trousers, or layered under jackets, it's an easy foundation piece that transitions seamlessly from casual daytime outfits to more elevated evening looks, making it a true wear-on-repeat staple for any season with effortless polish and everyday versatility built into one.

1048056964.description: The Edited by Maren Morris Boho Blouse blends free-spirited romance with an easy, modern sensibility. Cut in a relaxed silhouette, it offers subtle shape through an adjustable drawstring waist. Three tie closures and a modest placket introduce delicate, feminine detail, while lace trim adds a romantic finishing touch. The lined bodice provides comfortable coverage, balanced by airy semi-sheer sleeves finished with elastic cuffs for gentle volume and movement. Crafted from soft chiffon, the fabric feels lightweight and fluid throughout. A flattering V-neckline frames the look, and the hip-length design makes it a versatile staple for everyday styling. Offered in classic black and white and a paisley print, it brings effortless versatility to any wardrobe. Pair it with jeans for an effortless, laid-back outfit that feels polished enough for wherever the day takes you.

1048056965.description: Celebrate the Halloween season in style with this women's intarsia knit sweater, featuring playful and festive graphics like ghosts, pumpkins, black cats, and bold "Boo" lettering. Perfect for adding a touch of seasonal charm to your wardrobe, this sweater is ideal for Halloween parties, pumpkin patch visits, or a cozy night in.

1048056966.description: The Edited by Maren Morris Duster Cardigan is a romantic layering piece with an easy, free-spirited feel. Designed in a midweight knit, it features open knit detailing throughout that adds texture and an open, breathable feel. The V-neckline and longline silhouette that hits mid-calf create an elongated, flowing shape, while a touch of stretch keeps it comfortable and easy to wear. Finished with long sleeves and flared trumpet cuffs, it brings a bit of movement and drama to the sleeve, giving the piece a soft, expressive quality.Style it layered over a simple tank and straight-leg denim for an effortless everyday look, or wear it over a fitted dress with boots for an elevated outfit that still feels relaxed.
